observations.observation: Rio Tinto disclosed that its aluminium realised price comprises the LME price, a market premium and a value-added-product (VAP) premium. In H1 2025, average realised aluminium price including VAP premiums was $3,125/t versus average LME price of $2,539/t; average VAP product premium was $292/t, up 2% year over year, and VAP sales were 46% of primary metal sold.

claims.claim: The disclosed VAP premium provides direct source evidence that a portion of Rio Tinto aluminium sales realizes product-specific premiums above the underlying LME benchmark, materially advancing the previously unsupported pricingPower component without establishing group-wide pricing power.

limitations: This evidence is specific to aluminium and H1 2025; it does not establish pricing power across Rio Tinto's full commodity portfolio or justify a numeric score.
